persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 15-second vertical 9:16 ad for the bottle in my photo. Clean studio look, a few moving close-ups, mellow music, no talking. Start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”. Keep the bottle looking like mine.
bank.Product reference: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg; preserve its shape, finish and lid.
bank.Style and setting: Clean studio look with moving close-ups; background and colours are your call.
bank.Text: Start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”; no invented brand or product claims.
bank.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

messages.text: Could you make an ad for the bottle in this pic, keeping the bottle looking like mine? I’m a little worried it might end up looking like a different bottle once it’s turned into an ad. I’d like a clean studio look with a few moving close-ups, and the video should be 15 seconds long in vertical 9:16 format. For the words on screen, start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”. Please use mellow music with no talking.
